+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
+AUTH0_REFRESH_TOKEN = os.getenv("AUTH0_REFRESH_TOKEN")
+
+
+def refresh_session() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN or not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID or not AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET or not AUTH0_REFRESH_TOKEN:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing one or more Auth0 environment variables")
+
+    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token"
+    payload = {
+        "grant_type": "refresh_token",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "client_secret": AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET,
+        "refresh_token": AUTH0_REFRESH_TOKEN,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    result = refresh_session()
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+class Auth0EmailPasswordLoginError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def sign_in_with_email_password(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    domain = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+    client_id = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+
+    if not domain:
+        raise Auth0EmailPasswordLoginError("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
+    if not client_id:
+        raise Auth0EmailPasswordLoginError("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
+
+    url = f"https://{domain}/oauth/token"
+    payload = {
+        "grant_type": "password",
+        "username": email,
+        "password": password,
+        "audience": os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE"),
+        "scope": "openid profile email offline_access",
+        "client_id": client_id,
+    }
+    payload = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if v is not None}
+
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise Auth0EmailPasswordLoginError(response.text)
+
+    data = response.json()
+    return {
+        "access_token": data.get("access_token"),
+        "id_token": data.get("id_token"),
+        "refresh_token": data.get("refresh_token"),
+        "token_type": data.get("token_type"),
+        "expires_in": data.get("expires_in"),
+    }

*** Add File: register_user.py
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request, error
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str) -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ["FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY"]
+    url = f"https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signUp?key={api_key}"
+    payload = json.dumps({"email": email, "password": password, "returnSecureToken": True}).encode("utf-8")
+    req = request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+            return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except error.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(body) from exc
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: python register_user.py <email> <password>")
+    result = register_user(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
+    print(json.dumps(result))
*** End Patch
